The number ends in \(1\), so modulo \(5\) it is \(1\).

Its digit sum is \(279\), which is divisible by \(9\), so the number is \(0 \pmod 9\).

For remainder \(36\):
\[
36 \equiv 1 \pmod 5,\qquad 36 \equiv 0 \pmod 9
\]
Thus the number is congruent to \(36 \pmod{45}\). Therefore the divisor is \(45\).

\[
\boxed{45}
\]
